name: Gregory L. Deans
tagline: Top rated Personal Injury attorney in Dallas, Texas

about: Attorney Gregory L. Deans is the founding partner of Deans Stepp Law in Dallas, Texas. Widely regarded as one of the leading trial attorneys in his region, Mr. Deans provides unmatched representation and support to clients throughout the greater Dallas metro and surrounding areas who have legal needs involving any of the following:

Bringing over 28 years of total legal experience to the table, Mr. Deans has achieved considerable success protecting the rights and interests of his clients in complex, high-stakes litigation and arbitrations involving a host of legal disputes. Serving the needs of both plaintiff and defendants alike, he has recovered millions of dollars in settlements and verdicts for those with tortious and liability claims while securing favorable verdicts for those defending such claims, saving them millions in possible judgments.

At all turns, Mr. Deans maintains a constant focus on obtaining the most favorable outcome possible for his clients, no matter which side of the courtroom they are on. He has also gained a reputation for being able to deftly explain complicated legal and industry-specific terms in a way the judge and jury can easily grasp.

Recognized for his success, Mr. Deans has received consistent top rankings and endorsements from his peers, and D Magazine named him among the Best Lawyers in Dallas in 2019. In addition, Texas Monthly Magazine voted him a Top Attorney in Texas that same year, and America’s Top 100 named him as among the Top 100 High Stakes Litigators in North Texas for 2018-2019.

A 1989 graduate of Texas A&M University, Mr. Deans obtained his Juris Doctor from the University of Houston Law Center in 1992. He is admitted to practice before all U.S. District Courts in Texas as well as before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the 5th Circuit. He is also an active member of the Dallas Bar Association and the State Bar of Texas, among his other professional affiliations.
